title: Booker T’s last battle with Big Poppa Pump
summary: Scott Steiner’s violent championship pursuit interrupts Booker T’s rise. Their rivalry receives an unusual final payoff when both men bring championships to the last Nitro.

chapters.title: Steiner wins inside the cage
chapters.result: Steiner defeats Booker in a cage match for the world championship.
chapters.context: The challenger’s physical domination brings Booker’s reign to an end.

chapters.title: Booker leaves Nitro with both titles
chapters.result: United States champion Booker defeats world champion Steiner.
chapters.context: The winner-takes-all match makes Booker WCW’s final world champion before the promotion’s separate television run ends.
